probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Nordhavn Overview Buy Ella Mae Pilot Crew Ferry Models Pilot Crew Ferry Company About Team Investors Careers Media News Events Owners Service Charging Customer stories Contact Twelve Crew catamarans ordered for a North Sea wind farm An offshore operator has ordered twelve Crew boats to carry technicians to 140 turbines, charged from a station on the farm's own substation. Deliveries run through 2027. Published 14 September 2026 Category Orders Press contact [email protected] LinkedIn Copy link An offshore wind operator has ordered twelve Crew catamarans for a 140 turbine farm in the Dutch sector of the North Sea. It is the largest single order in Nordhavn’s history. The boats are C22s in the turbine transfer layout, each carrying 24 technicians, a folding crane and eight tonnes of cargo. They will charge from a station built on the farm’s own offshore substation, so they never need to return to port to top up during a working day. Delivery plan The first two boats leave the yard in March 2027 and the last in December. Our service team will be based in Esbjerg and Rotterdam, with a spare pack and a loan boat held for the farm. The order brings the book to 41 boat
